blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agile robots require spatiotemporal intelligence to interpret scenes, reason about interactions, and anticipate future events. Yet it remains unclear how well foundation vision models support these capabilities, particularly from a moving egocentric camera, which is a natural view for robots. To investigate this, we collect an annotated tennis dataset and train a suite of vision models on spatiotemporal tasks. Our dataset contains egocentric video synchronized with five allocentric videos, estimated global positions, labeled contact times, and annotated stroke types. We then evaluate seven prediction tasks from egocentric images: 2D ego player and 3D ball localization, future player and ball trajectories, forehand or backhand stroke anticipation, time to the next ego player ball contact, and 3D ball position at that contact. We compare image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models with jointly trained prediction heads. The best performing models achieve mean current-frame localization errors of 0.14 m for the ego player and 0.54 m for the ball, future forecasting errors of 0.34 m for the ego player and 0.91 m for the ball over 1.1 s, and a mean contact-time prediction error of 0.14 s. Auxiliary depth information substantially improves 3D ball localization, suggesting that inferring metric depth remains a challenge. Longer image histories do not improve ball forecasting, indicating that representations exploit scene context rather than rely solely on inter-frame motion. Finally, we propose a conditional diffusion model to generate whole-body kinematic tennis motion from vision encoder predictions on egocentric video at real-time rates, adapting movements as predictions are refined. These results move towards a deeper understanding of how foundation vision models can support real-time dynamic robots using egocentric video.
blocks.zh: 敏捷的机器人需要spatiotemporal智能来解释场景,互动的原因,以及预测未来的事件. 然而,仍然不清楚基础视觉模型在多大程度上支持了这些能力,特别是从一个动人的以自负为中心的相机,这是机器人的自然视野. 为了调查这一点,我们收集了一个注解的网球数据集,并培训一套关于瞬间任务的视觉模型。 我们的数据集包含以自我为中心的视频, 与五部以全方位为主的视频同步, 然后我们从以自我为中心的图像来评价7个预测任务: 二维自负球手和 三维自负球本地化, 未来的自负球手和球轨迹, 前手或后手中风预测, 时间到下一个自负球手球接触, 3D自负球在那个接触的位置。 我们比较图像编码器,视频编码器, 和视觉语言模型 与联合训练的预测头。 表现最好的模型实现的平均值为自负球员0.14米和球员0.54米的当前帧本地化误差,自负球员未来的预测误差为0.34米和球员超过1.1 s的0.91米,平均接触时间预测误差为0.14 s. 辅助深度信息大大地改善了3D球本地化,表明推断出公制深度仍然是一个挑战. 更长的图像历史并不能改善球的预测,表明表现会利用场景背景,而不是仅仅依靠帧间运动. 最后,我们提出一个有条件的传播模型,从视觉编码器的预测中产生全身运动网球运动,以实时的速度对以自我为中心的视频进行预测,随着预测的完善而适应运动. 这些结果逐渐更深入地理解了基础视觉模型如何利用以自负为中心的视频支持实时动态机器人.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Advances in robot hardware and learned controllers are enabling increasingly agile whole-body movements [ 1 ] and athletic behaviors [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] , but coordinating these movements with fast objects and other agents requires visual processing to be sufficiently accurate and timely to guide immediate action. This motivates spatial intelligence that supports both estimating the current state of the environment and anticipating its evolution [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 机器人硬件和有学识的控制器的进步使得全身运动[1]和运动行为[2,3,4]变得日益敏捷,但这些运动与快速物体和其他物剂的协调需要视觉处理足够准确和及时,以指导立即采取行动. 这激发了空间智能,既有助于估计环境的现状,又有助于预测环境的演变[5、6、7]。

blocks.en:
Spatial intelligence of vision-language models has been studied with question-answering techniques that probe their understanding of where objects and agents are located and how they are oriented [ 6 , 8 ] .
Accounting for how these relations evolve over time extends the scope to spatiotemporal intelligence [ 7 ] .
We further distinguish understanding from forecasting [ 9 ] – understanding seeks to infer current spatial configurations, motions, and action cues from observed inputs, while forecasting aims to predict future states or actions using current and past observations. Representations that expose this information can support downstream visuomotor control and embodied planning [ 10 , 11 ] , while learned world models can predict future representations to guide action [ 12 , 13 ] . These applications motivate evaluating what information is accessible in large-scale pretrained visual representations and how adaptation affects their usefulness [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
利用问答技术研究了视觉语言模型的空间情报,这些技术探究了物体和物剂所在位置及其方向[6,8]。
说明这些关系如何随时间演变,将范围扩大到瞬间智能[7].
我们进一步区分理解与预测[9] — — 理解试图从观测到的投入中推断当前的空间配置、运动和行动提示,而预测则旨在利用当前和过去的观测预测未来状态或行动。 披露这种信息的表述方式可以支持下游机动车控制和体现规划[10,11],而学习过的世界模型可以预测未来的表述方式来指导行动[12,13]. 这些应用激励人们评估哪些信息在大规模预先培训的视觉表现中可以获得,以及适应如何影响其效用[14]。

blocks.en: We use tennis as a concrete setting to explore perceptual demands of highly dynamic sports: localizing players and fast-moving objects, anticipating trajectories, and coordinating body motion for imminent contacts [ 5 , 15 , 16 ] . Returning a tennis ball couples these capabilities – spatial accuracy and timing are crucial since the players and ball continue moving during perception, planning, and execution [ 17 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们用网球作为具体的环境,探索极具活力的体育运动的感知要求:使球员和快速移动的物体本地化,预测轨迹,以及协调即将接触的身体运动[5,15,16]. 将网球夫妇送回网球,这些能力 — — 空间精确度和时机至关重要,因为球员和球在感知、规划和执行期间继续运动[17,4]。

blocks.en: There have been three main data modalities used by robots tackling these challenges. First, dedicated spatial sensing uses mocap ( mocap ) sensors or calibrated camera systems to directly estimate player and ball positions for trajectory forecasting and control [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 17 ] . Second, allocentric videos , recorded by external cameras at fixed court locations, support ball tracking and trajectory analysis [ 18 , 19 ] , player behavior modeling, simulated skill learning [ 20 , 21 ] , and spatial question-answering with foundation vision-language models [ 22 ] . Third, egocentric perception , recorded from a player-worn camera, has addressed image-space instance segmentation, forehand action phases, and pose estimation of other players [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] . Egocentric cues such as gaze [ 26 ] and head orientation may also reveal aspects of attention and strategy that are less apparent from allocentric views.
blocks.zh: 机器人应对这些挑战使用了三种主要的数据模式。 首先,专用空间感应使用mocap(mocap)传感器或校准相机系统直接估算玩家和球位,用于轨迹预测和控制[3, 4, 5, 17]. 第二,全方位视频,由固定法庭地点的外部摄像机录制,支持球跟踪和轨迹分析[18,19],玩家行为模型,模拟技能学习[20,21],空间问答与基础视觉语言模型[22]. 第三,从玩家-worn相机录制的自我中心感知,解决了图像-空间实例分割,前置动作阶段,对其他玩家作出估计[23,24,25]. 诸如目视[26]和头部定向等偏心提示也可能揭示出从偏心观点中不太明显的关注和战略方面.

blocks.en:
For autonomous dynamic robots, egocentric video is especially relevant because it relies solely on a body-mounted camera rather than external sensors – it thus removes workspace limitations and infrastructure demands. However, this viewpoint presents a demanding test of perception: body and head motion mix camera and object motion, court landmarks and relevant objects leave the field of view, and dynamic objects such as a ball can appear small, blurred, or partially occluded.
The joint ability of foundation visual representations to support metric player and object state estimation and causal forecasting throughout such egocentric video of dynamic tasks remains insufficiently characterized.
blocks.zh:
对于自主的动态机器人来说,以自我为中心的视频特别相关,因为它完全依赖于机身搭载的相机而不是外部传感器,从而消除了工作空间的限制和基础设施需求. 然而,这种观点对感知提出了要求很高的考验:身体和头部运动混合相机和物体运动,宫廷地标和相关物体离开视野,球等动态物体可能显得小,模糊,或部分被占据.
这些以自我为中心的动态任务视频中,基础视觉表现支持度量玩家和对象状态估计和因果预测的共同能力仍然不够突出。

blocks.en: We therefore ask: How well do foundation vision models support spatial understanding and forecasting from dynamic egocentric video?
blocks.zh: 因此,我们要求: 基础视觉模型从动态自我中心视频中支持空间理解和预测的程度如何?

blocks.en: To support this evaluation, we collect a tennis dataset with synchronized video from a head-worn egocentric camera and five allocentric cameras. We annotate this data with segmentations and localization information via a custom pipeline that fuses automated inferences and manual labeling.
blocks.zh: 为了支持这一评估,我们收集了网球数据集,其中同步视频来自头部自负式摄像机和五台全方位摄像机. 我们通过自动推论和人工标签的自定义管道,将这些数据与分区和本地化信息进行注释。

blocks.en: We then use the egocentric frames as model inputs and evaluate seven spatiotemporal understanding and forecasting tasks split into four groups. Spatial state estimation predicts the current 2D ego player position and 3D ball position. Spatial state forecasting predicts the future 2D ego motion and 3D ball motion. Stroke anticipation predicts whether the ego player’s next stroke will be forehand or backhand. Contact anticipation predicts the remaining time until the ego player’s racket-ball contact and the 3D ball position at contact. Together, these tasks probe the spatial and temporal understanding of pre-trained visual representations.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们使用以自我为中心的框架作为模型投入,并评价七个瞬间理解和预测任务分成四组。 空间状态估计预测当前2D自负球员位置和3D球员位置. 空间状态预测预测未来2D自负运动和3D球运动. 弦乐预测自我玩家的下一击是前手还是后手。 接触预期会预测到自我球员的球拍球接触和3D球在接触中的位置之前的剩余时间. 这些任务共同探索了预先训练的视觉表现的空间和时间理解.

blocks.en: We select 13 vision encoders spanning image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models (VLMs). We attach lightweight prediction heads to each encoder’s output visual token stream, train the encoder and probes jointly on all tasks, and evaluate prediction accuracy on held-out rallies. We consistently observe 3D ball prediction errors and 2D ego player localization errors that are on par with expected ball motion across 1–2 frames and expected player motion across 3–7 frames, indicating promising dynamic performance.
blocks.zh: 我们选择13个视觉编码器, 包括图像编码器、视频编码器和视觉语言模型。 我们在每个编码器输出的视觉信号流上加上轻量级的预测头,对所有任务一起训练编码器和探测器,并评估被搁置集会的预测准确性。 我们一直观察到3D球预测错误和2D自负球员本地化错误,这些错误与1–2帧的预期球运动和3–7帧的预期球员运动相同,表明有希望的动态性能.

blocks.en: We perform ablations to investigate representations, dynamic information, and horizon lengths. Ball prediction errors reduce significantly with supplementary depth information, indicating that metric depth estimation is weakly encoded in the visual representations. Longer conditioning histories do not improve 3D position inference; in fact, image encoders achieve identical ball forecasting performance with only one conditioning frame, relying instead on other spatial correlations to predict future motion. We study the impact of rally phase and horizon length, finding that higher temporal proximity to ego–ball contact time reduces ball localization error but increases ego player localization error, and that ball prediction error increases with the forecasting horizon.
blocks.zh: 我们在调查陈述、动态资料和视野长度时, 球的预测错误随着补充深度信息而显著减少,表明度量深度估计在视觉表达中编码得微弱. 更长的调制历史并不能改善3D位置推论;事实上,图像编码器在只有一个调制框的情况下实现相同的球预测性能,而是依靠其他空间相关性来预测未来的运动. 我们研究凝聚相和视野长度的影响,发现距离自我-球接触时间更近会减少球的本地化错误,但会增加自我玩家的本地化错误,而球的预测错误会随着预测视野的增加而增加.

blocks.en: Finally, we connect egocentric video understanding to whole-body tennis motion generation through a conditional motion diffusion model [ 27 ] . Trained on our dataset, the diffusion model uses the above vision-based predictions of racket–ball contact position, time remaining until contact, and whether the ball is approaching or departing (derived from ball forecasting) as conditioning information. As new visual observations refine contact time and position estimates, the model adaptively re-plans its whole-body kinematic motion. The planning system is instantiated with a finetuned vision-only variant of the LFM2.5-VL-450M [ 28 ] , which is the fastest of our evaluated VLM-derived models and capable of 100 Hz 100\text{\,}\mathrm{H}\mathrm{z} inference on modern desktop GPUs. This pipeline demonstrates the utility of pre-trained spatiotemporal representations for downstream real-time robot applications.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们通过有条件的运动传播模型,将自我中心视频理解与全身网球运动生成联系起来[27]. 在我们的数据集上,扩散模型使用上述基于球拍-球接触位置的视觉预测、接触前的剩余时间以及球是否接近或离开(从球预测中得出)作为条件信息。 随着新的视觉观察完善了接触时间和位置估计,模型适应性地重新规划了全身运动. 规划系统以LFM2.5-VL-450M[28]的微调唯视变体即时化,这是我们评价的VLM衍生模型中最快的,能够对现代桌面GPU进行100Hz 100\text~,}\mathrm{H}\mathrm{z}推论. 这一管道表明,经过预先训练的瞬间表示可用于下游实时机器人应用。

blocks.en: Key contributions are as follows: • A tennis video dataset of 85 85 rallies with 53 , 155 53,155 egocentric frames and five synchronized allocentric views, annotated with 3D ball trajectories, 2D court-frame player trajectories, stroke type labels, and contact times, to be released upon acceptance of the paper. • A systematic evaluation of foundation vision model representations for seven tasks of spatiotemporal understanding and forecasting from egocentric tennis videos. • Empirical findings that (i) spatiotemporal task performance is comparable across image encoders and VLMs, but not the video encoder; (ii) supplementary depth information reduces ball localization error by 50–60%; (iii) longer conditioning histories yield little benefit. • A conditional diffusion model that generates whole-body kinematic tennis motion conditioned on predictions from a vision encoder trained on egocentric video.

blocks.en: II Dataset Curation and Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: II 数据集校正和注释管道

blocks.en: II-A Synchronized Egocentric and Allocentric Videos
blocks.zh: II-A 同步 Egocent 和 Alsocent 视频

blocks.en: To collect a detailed video dataset of tennis play, we recorded an expert tennis player using a head-mounted egocentric camera and five static allocentric cameras in an outdoor setting. Four static cameras were placed at eye level at each corner of the half-court on which the ego player was playing, and one static camera raised high above the ground was centered behind the court; the locations are illustrated in Figure 2 . The egocentric camera yielded video at 29.97 29.97 frames per second with resolution 3840 3840 × \times 2160 2160 pixels. The allocentric cameras yielded video at 29.97 29.97 or 59.94 59.94 frames per second with resolution at least 5120 5120 × \times 2880 2880 pixels.
blocks.zh: 为了收集网球比赛的详细视频数据集,我们录制了一名专家网球运动员,使用头架自负式摄像机和5台静态全向式摄像机在室外布置. 在自大玩家所玩的半个球场的每个角落都放置了四台静态照相机,在球场后方的地面上高举了一台静态照相机;地点见图2。 以自我为中心的相机以29.9729.97帧每秒生成视频,分辨率为3840 3840 ×\times 2160 2160像素. 全景相机以29.97 29.97或59.94 59.94帧每秒产生视频,分辨率至少为5120 5120 ×\times 2880 2880 像素.

blocks.en: All cameras recorded continuously for approximately 80 80 minutes. Manual annotations then marked the start and end times of each rally, and the contact times of each shot. After extracting only the active times within rallies, the dataset spans approximately 29.6 29.6 minutes ( 53 , 155 53,155 egocentric frames) across 85 85 rallies. Each rally is segmented from the opening shot to its annotated end: the final racket-ball contact, second bounce, or net contact. The rallies included 557 557 shots by the ego player and 574 574 shots by the opponent. The ego player’s shots included 328 328 forehands and 229 229 backhands.
blocks.zh: 所有摄像头连续拍摄约8080分钟. 手动说明随后标记了每次集会的开始和结束时间,以及每次射击的接触时间. 数据集只提取了集会内的活跃时间后,在85个85个集会中,大约跨度为29.6分(53,155,53,155个自我中心框架). 每次集会从开场镜头分到附加说明的结尾:最后的球拍球接触,第二次反弹,或净接触. 集会包括自负球员的557,557枪和对手的574,574枪. 自我玩家的镜头包括328-328前手和229-229反手.

blocks.en: The rallies span both free play ( 29 29 rallies) and structured practice ( 56 56 rallies), with the latter including four different patterns designed to capture diverse ego player movement across the court. The resulting distributions of the ball and player locations within frames of the extracted rallies are illustrated in Figure 2 .

blocks.en: II-B Camera Synchronization and Calibration
blocks.zh: II-B 相机同步与校准

blocks.en: At the beginning and end of the session, the ego player clapped three times. This synchronization signal, visible in all videos, was used in post-processing for manual alignment.
blocks.zh: 在会话的开始和结束时,自负的玩家猛烈扑了三次. 这种同步信号在所有视频中可见,用于手动对齐的处理后.

blocks.en: Calibration was performed in post-processing with a pinhole camera model, since all cameras use a linear field of view. Camera intrinsics are recovered from a charuco ( charuco ) calibration board that was held in front of allocentric cameras at the start of the session, and extrinsics are solved via pnp ( pnp ) with labeled court-corner correspondences, using OpenCV [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 校准是在后处理中用针孔相机模型进行,因为所有的相机都使用线性视场. 相机的内在内容是从会场开始时在全心全意相机前举行的一个charuco(charuco)校准板中回收的,外部通过pnp(pnp)解决,并带有标注的法院-corner通信,使用OpenCV[29].

blocks.en: II-C State Estimation and Annotation
blocks.zh: 二-C 国家估计和说明

blocks.en: We annotate recorded videos with information about the physical state and the upcoming play strategy. This includes the ball position, the ego player position, and whether the ego player will next make a forehand or backhand stroke.
blocks.zh: 我们整理录像, 这包括球位,自负球员的位置,以及自负球员接下来是先手还是后手中风.

blocks.en: II-C 1 Ball and Player Position Estimation
blocks.zh: II-C 1 球和球员位置估计

blocks.en:
We use the three allocentric cameras at the back of the court to estimate the ball and ego player positions. We first annotate the videos with ball and player pixel locations; after downscaling to 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 resolution, we use an off-the-shelf tennis ball tracker [ 30 ] and a general-purpose object detector [ 31 ] to obtain initial per-frame 2D anchors for the ball and ego player, which we then manually review and correct.
Manual corrections were required for the ball and player annotations in approximately 30.5% and 5.8% of frames, respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们用法庭后面的三台全心全意的摄像头来估计球和自负球员的位置. 我们首先用球和玩家像素位置对视频进行注释;在缩小到1280×720 1280\times 720分辨率后,我们使用现成的网球球追踪器[30]和通用物体探测器[31]为球和自负球手获得初始的每帧2D锚,然后我们手动审查和纠正.
球和球员说明分别需要手动校正约30.5%和5.8%的帧.

blocks.en: We then fuse the pixel annotations from multiple cameras by triangulating the three calibrated and corrected 2D views using a dlt ( dlt ) solver to produce 3D ball and ego player position labels. The ball is triangulated freely in 3D, whereas the ego player localization uses a planar constraint to recover the foot-ground contact point on the 2D court plane, approximated as the bottom-center of the detected bounding box. At the downscaled 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 resolution, median reprojection errors across the three views span 2.1–4.4 px for the ball and 3.3--9.7 px for the player. Ball and player positions are available for 99.9 % 99.9\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} and 100 % 100\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of frames, respectively; triangulation requires valid 2D detections in at least two views, otherwise the frame is left unlabeled.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们通过三边校准和校正3D视图,通过dlt(dlt)解析器将像素说明从多个相机中熔化,生成3D球和自我玩家位置标签. 球在3D中自由三角化,而自负玩家的本地化则使用平板限制来恢复2D球场平面上的脚底接触点,大致为检测到的边框的底中心. 在降级的1280×720 1280\times 720分辨率下,跨三个视图的中位重排误差在球的2.1–4.4 px和球员的3.3–9.7 px之间. 球和玩家位置分别可以使用99.9%的99.9\text~,QQ mathrm{\%}和100%的100\text~,XX mathrm{\%}的帧;三角形需要至少两个视图中有效的2D检测,否则帧没有标记.

blocks.en: We also annotate the ball’s 2D position in the egocentric view. The resulting egocentric ball position is available for 97.4% of frames; the remainder are occlusions.
blocks.zh: 我们也在以自我为中心的观点中标注了球的2D位置。 由此形成的自我中心球位置可达97.4%的帧;其余为隐形.

blocks.en: II-C 2 Stroke Type Annotations
blocks.zh: II-C 2 中标类型说明

blocks.en: To provide information about play strategy and motion prediction, we annotate the time of each ego player ball contact and whether it was a forehand or backhand . We also record the time of each opponent contact.
blocks.zh: 为了提供游戏策略和运动预测的信息,我们记录每个自负球员接触的时间,以及它是前手还是后手。 我们还记录每个对手接触的时间.

blocks.en: III Vision Foundation Model Representations
blocks.zh: 三 展望基金会示范代表机构

blocks.en: III-A Vision Models
blocks.zh: 三-A 远景模式

blocks.en: We evaluate a diverse set of vision models spanning image encoders, video encoders, and VLMs to assess how pretrained visual representations support egocentric tennis prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了一套不同的视觉模型, 包括图像编码器、视频编码器和VLM,

blocks.en: III-A 1 Image Encoders
blocks.zh: III-A 1 图像编码器

blocks.en: We consider four image encoders selected for their ubiquity and comparatively distinct training paradigms: DINOv3 [ 32 ] is self-supervised, SigLIP 2 [ 33 ] is language-supervised with contrastive and captioning objectives and is the vision tower of many VLMs, Depth Anything 3 (DA3) [ 34 ] post-trains a DINOv2 backbone with dense depth supervision, and SAM 3 [ 35 ] post-trains a Perception Encoder [ 36 ] backbone with dense segmentation supervision. We use checkpoints of comparable capacity: DINOv3 ViT-L/16 (300M), SigLIP 2 So400M/16 (400M), DA3-L (ViT-L/14, 300M), and SAM 3 (PE ViT-L+/14, 450M), i.e. ViT-L-class backbones [ 37 ] with 300–450M parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,四个图像编码器因其无所不在和相对不同的培训范式而选定:DINOv3[32]是自我监督的,SigLIP 2[33]是语言监督的,具有对比性和标题性目标,是许多VLM的视觉塔,深度Anything 3(DA3)[34]在DNOv2后设置的具有密集深度监督的DINov2主干线,以及SAM 3[35]后设置的Pepion Encoder[36] 具有密集分区监督的骨干。 我们使用具有类似能力的检查站:DINov3 ViT-L/16(300M)、SigLIP 2 So400M/16(400M)、DA3-L(ViT-L/14、300M)和SAM 3(PE ViT-L+/14、450M),即具有300-450M参数的Vit-L级骨干[37]。

blocks.en: III-A 2 Video Encoders
blocks.zh: III-A 2 视频编码器

blocks.en: V-JEPA 2 [ 13 ] is a video encoder self-supervised to predict masked latent representations. We use the ViT-L/16 checkpoint (300M) with 2 × 16 × 16 2\times 16\times 16 tubelet patches, matching the capacity of the image encoders for multi-frame processing.
blocks.zh: V-JEPA 2[13]是一个视频编码器自我监督,以预测隐蔽的潜在表现. 我们使用Vit-L/16检查点(300M),配备2×16×16 2\times 16\times 16 tubelet补丁,匹配图像编码器的容量进行多帧处理.

blocks.en: III-A 3 Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: III-A 3 远景规划模式

blocks.en: We consider three VLMs at the 3–4B scale: Qwen3-VL-4B [ 38 ] , LFM2.5-VL-3B [ 28 ] , and PLM-3B [ 39 ] , whose vision towers derive from SigLIP 2-Large (300M), SigLIP 2 So400m NaFlex (400M), and the Perception Encoder [ 36 ] , respectively. Because the encoders differ, we isolate the contribution of the language backbone and multimodal training by evaluating each VLM both as a vision tower alone and with its full language stack. We additionally include LFM2.5-VL-450M, whose 86M-parameter vision tower is several times smaller than those of the larger VLMs, as a compute-constrained variant to enable downstream real-time planning experiments (Section IV-F ).
blocks.zh: 我们考虑在3–4B尺度上的三个VLM:Qune3-VL-4B[38],LFM2.5-VL-3B[28],和PLM-3B[39],其视觉塔分别来自SigLIP 2-拉格(300M),SigLIP 2 So400m NaFlex(400M)和Pepeption Encoder [36]. 由于编码器不同,我们孤立了语言主干线和多式联运培训的贡献,将每个VLM单独评价为一个视觉塔,并配有完整的语言堆栈. 我们还包括LFM2.5-VL-450M,其86M参数的视塔比较大的VLM小数倍,作为计算受限的变体,以便能够进行下游实时规划实验(第四节-F节)。

blocks.en: III-B Backbone Adaptation
blocks.zh: III-B 背骨适应

blocks.en: III-B 1 Prediction Head
blocks.zh: III-B 1 预测头

blocks.en: To adapt visual representations with minimal computational overhead, we attach task-specific prediction heads to the encoder’s output token stream (patch embeddings and, for VLMs, language tokens). Each head applies cross-attention from learnable queries (one per output, N N for N N -step forecasts) to the token stream, followed by a 2-layer MLP. All heads are trained jointly on a shared encoder and share an additive positional embedding over the tapped tokens. We use an L2 loss (weight 1.0) for continuous targets and a cross-entropy loss (weight 0.1) for stroke type.
blocks.zh: 为了在最小的计算间接费用下调整视觉表现,我们在编码器的输出符号流(patch嵌入和,对于VLM,语言符号)上附加特定任务预测头. 每个头从可学习的询问(每个输出一个,N N代表N - step 预测)到符号流,然后是2层的MLP. 所有头部都接受关于共享编码器的联合培训,并共享在窃听符上嵌入的添加剂位置。 我们使用L2损失(重量1.0)作为连续目标,使用交叉性损失(重量0.1)作为中风类型.

blocks.en: III-B 2 Fine-tuning and Training Details
blocks.zh: 三、B.2 调整和培训细节

blocks.en: All experiments use a batch size of 32 and 30 training epochs. We use a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the newly initialized prediction heads and 10 − 5 10^{-5} for the pretrained vision backbones. For vision-language models, the language component is finetuned using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 40 ] rather than full-parameter fine-tuning. Thus, our fine-tuning protocol involves up to three components: a fully trained prediction head, a vision backbone finetuned at a reduced learning rate, and a parameter-efficient LoRA adaptation of the language model.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用批量大小的32和30个训练时代. 我们用10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4 10 - 4 5 的学习率来计算新初始化的预测头和10 - 5 10 - 5 5 的预训视觉骨干。 对于视觉语言模型,语言成分使用Low-Rank适应(LORA)[40]进行微调,而不是全参数微调. 因此,我们的微调协议涉及最多三个部分:一个训练有素的预测头,一个以较低的学习率微调的视觉主干,以及一个参数效率高的语言模型LORA的改造.

blocks.en: III-B 3 Vision Tower and Vision-Language Settings
blocks.zh: III-B 3 视觉塔和视觉语言设置

blocks.en: We evaluate VLMs in two settings. In the vision-tower setting, we retain only the vision tower, using its post-projector tokens as the representation stream. In the vision-language setting, we include both the vision and language components. In line with practices in VLM fine-tuning for auxiliary tasks [ 41 ] , we tap representations located 50% through language tower depth and discard the second half. For all VLMs in the vision-language setting, we inject a standardized text prompt after the encoded image tokens to describe the overall task goal.
blocks.zh: 我们在两种情况下评估VLM. 在视觉塔设置中,我们只保留视觉塔,使用其投影后标志作为代表流. 在愿景语言背景下,我们既包括愿景,也包括语言部分。 根据VLM微调辅助任务的做法[41],我们通过语言塔深度挖掘50%的表示,并丢弃下半部分. 对于视觉语言设定中的所有VLM,我们在编码的图像符号后注入一个标准化文本提示来描述总体任务目标.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 四. 实验结果和讨论

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate all models on the same fixed data splits. Rallies are assigned wholly to one split, so that no temporal window crosses a rally boundary. Splits are stratified across each of the drill sub-types and free-play, to avoid rally type imbalances. The realized split ratios are 63.1 % 63.1\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} train, 17.7 % 17.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} validation, 19.2 % 19.2\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} test, corresponding to 53 53 / 16 16 / 16 16 rallies. Training occurs on NVIDIA B200 and H200 GPUs; individual run durations vary between 4–24 hours depending on the model.
blocks.zh: 我们用相同的固定数据来评估所有模型。 Rallies完全被分配到一个分裂区,这样时间窗口就不会跨越集合边界。 拆分在每一个钻子类型和自由游戏中进行分层,以避免集合类型失衡. 实际的拆分比率为63.1% 63.1\text=,Q}\mathrm{\%}列车,17.7% 17.7\text=,Q}\mathrm{\%}验证,19.2% 19.2\text=,X}\mathrm{\%}测试,对应53 53/16 16/16集会. 培训是在NVIDIA B200和H200GPU上进行的;个人运行时间视型号的不同而不同,在4-24小时之间.

blocks.en: IV-B Multi-Task Prediction
blocks.zh: IV-B 多任务预测

blocks.en: Each model receives two images as input: the current “anchor” frame and one preceding frame 0.1 s (3 frames) earlier. We jointly optimize seven prediction heads covering five targets. 3D ball position and 2D player position are each predicted at the anchor frame and over a horizon of 12 future frames spanning 33 time steps (1.10 s). Shot type classifies the upcoming stroke as forehand or backhand. Time to contact predicts the time until the ego player’s next ball contact. Ball position at contact predicts 3D ball position at that time.
blocks.zh: 每个模型都收到两个图像作为输入:目前的“锁定”框架和先前的一个0.1 s (3 帧)框架。 我们共同优化了七个预测头,涵盖五个目标。 3D球位置和2D球员位置在锚架和跨越33个时间步(1.10 s)的12个未来帧的视野上分别预测. 射击类型将即将出现的中风归类为前手或反手. 联系时间会预测到自我球员下一个球接触的时间。 接触时的球位置预测3D球在当时的位置.

blocks.en: Table I reports test-split metrics for all 13 configurations. Current-frame 3D ball errors range from 0.54 0.54 m (PLM 3B) to 0.90 0.90 m (V-JEPA 2). VLMs and vision towers fall within a narrower band ( 0.54 0.54 to 0.71 0.71 m, with Qwen3-VL highest), and image encoders are the most tightly clustered ( 0.55 0.55 to 0.60 0.60 m). Current-frame 2D player errors vary less across models ( 0.14 0.14 to 0.18 0.18 m), with DA3 lowest. Forecasting separates the models more clearly: PLM 3B attains the lowest future ball error ( 0.91 0.91 m) and V-JEPA 2 by far the highest ( 1.27 1.27 m), yet V-JEPA 2 attains the lowest future player error ( 0.34 0.34 m) and retains this advantage across the full horizon, while its ball error remains the highest throughout (Fig. 3 (d)). Shot-type accuracy is near-saturated for all models ( 98.2 98.2 to 99.9 % 99.9\% ), and time-to-contact errors fall within a narrow range of 141 141 to 149 149 ms; Fig. 3 shows how ball and contact errors evolve as contact approaches. Adding the language stack yields small gains for the three larger VLMs, most notably for PLM 3B on ball-related tasks. Overall, image encoders and VLMs perform comparably; PLM 3B leads on ball tasks and, together with LFM2.5-VL 3B, SAM 3, and DA3, is the most consistently performant across spatial tasks, while Qwen3-VL trails slightly on ball localization and V-JEPA 2 is weakest on ball localization but strongest on player forecasting.
blocks.zh: 表一报告所有13个配置的测试-分解度量。 目前机身3D球误差范围为0.54 0.54米(PLM 3B)至0.90 0.90米(V-JEPA 2). VLM和视塔属于较窄的波段(0.54 0.54至0.71 0.71米,其中Quen3-VL最高),图像编码器是最紧密的集群(0.55 0.55至0.60 0.60米). 当前帧2D玩家在各种型号上的差异较小(0.140.14到0.180.18米),DA3最低. 预测更明确地将模型分开:PLM 3B获得未来最低的球差错(0.91 0.91米),V-JEPA 2获得迄今为止最高的球差(1.27 1.27米),然而V-JEPA 2获得未来最低的球员差错(0.34 0.34米),并在整个地平线上保持这一优势,而其球差错始终是最高的(图3(d)). 所有型号的射击型精度接近饱和度(98.2 98.2至99.9% 99.9\%),时间到接触误差在141 141至149 149 ms的狭小范围内; Fig. 3显示球和接触错误如何随着接触接近而演变. 加入语言堆栈对三个较大的VLM产生小收益,最显著的是球相关任务的PLM 3B. 总体而言,图像编码器和VLM的性能是相容的;PLM 3B领先于球任务,与LFM2.5-VL 3B,SAM 3和DA3一起,是跨空间任务中表现最一致的,而Qune3-VL小径则略微在球局部化上,V-JEPA 2在球局部化上表现最弱,但在玩家预测上表现最强.

blocks.en: IV-C Injecting Information to Probe Spatial Representations
blocks.zh: IV-C 将信息注入探索空间表现

blocks.en: We study how providing auxiliary inputs from the annotations to the prediction head affects 3D ball localization, using SigLIP 2 finetuned with a single head for the anchor-frame ball position. We consider three inputs: the ball’s 2D image position in the ego frame ( ball ), the ego player’s 2D court position ( player ), and the planar ego-ball distance ( depth ), each evaluated individually and in all pairwise and full combinations. Inputs are sinusoidally embedded and injected into the head’s cross-attention block via adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) [ 42 ] . As a control, we train an image-free MLP on the auxiliary inputs alone.
blocks.zh: 我们研究从注解中向预测头提供辅助投入如何影响3D球局部化,使用SigLIP 2对锚框球位置进行单头微调. 我们考虑三种投入:球的2D图像位置在自负框架(球),自负球手的2D球场位置(球员),以及平面自负-球的距离(深度),每个球都单独评估,并进行双向和完全组合。 输入物通过适应层正常化(AdaLN)[42] 嵌入和注入头部的交叉注意力区块。 作为一个控制器,我们单独在辅助输入上训练一个无图像的MLP.

blocks.en: As shown in Table II , depth reduces error from 0.51 m 0.51\text{\,}\mathrm{m} (image only) to 0.21 m 0.21\text{\,}\mathrm{m} , and combining it with player yields the lowest error ( 0.19 m 0.19\text{\,}\mathrm{m} ). Yet ball and player alone provide no benefit, and adding ball slightly degrades the combinations. This suggests that depth supplies geometric information hard to infer from images, but ball pixel position is redundant with visual representation. The image-free MLP also benefits most from depth , but unlike SigLIP 2, it gains more from ball , performing best with all three inputs ( 1.07 m 1.07\text{\,}\mathrm{m} ). The substantially higher errors of image-free MLP variants show that the auxiliary inputs alone cannot replace visual data.
blocks.zh: 如表二所示,深度将错误从0.51 m 0.51\ text~,QQ mathrm{m}(仅图像)降至0.21 m 0.21\ text~,QQ mathrm{m},将其与玩家的组合产生最小错误(0.19 m 0.19\ text~,XQ mathrm{m}). 然而,单靠球和球员是没有好处的,加上球会略微降低组合. 这表明深度提供几何信息,很难从图像中推断,但球像素位置是多余的,具有视觉表现力. 无图像的 MLP 也从深度得到最大的好处,但是与SigLIP 2 不同的是,它从球获得更多的收益,以所有三个输入(1.07 m 1.07\text ~,}\mathrm{m})表现最好. 无图像 MLP 变体的明显较高的错误表明,仅靠辅助输入无法取代视觉数据.

blocks.en: IV-D Varying History to Probe Temporal Representations
blocks.zh: IV-D 不同历史到探究时间表现

blocks.en: We study how probed visual representations encode temporal context through history conditioning by varying the number and spacing of input frames while predicting future 3D ball position. In Table III , we finetune SigLIP 2 on four settings and V-JEPA 2 on three, omitting single-frame history since tubelets must be at least length 2.
blocks.zh: 我们研究如何在预测未来3D球位置的同时,通过历史调节,通过对输入框的数量和间距的不同来探测视觉表达方式编码时间背景. 在表三中,我们微调了SigLIP 2的4个设置和V-JEPA 2的3个设置,省略了单帧历史,因为管子必须至少2长.

blocks.en: An image-free MLP trained on ground truth 3D ball positions shows the necessity of temporal information: from a single position it cannot forecast ( 2.92 m 2.92\text{\,}\mathrm{m} error), but a second position 100 ms 100\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{s} earlier suffices to estimate velocity and reduces error to 0.30 m 0.30\text{\,}\mathrm{m} , with longer or denser history providing only modest further gains.
blocks.zh: 在地面真理3D球位置上训练的无图像 MLP 显示时间信息的必要性:从一个单一的位置上它无法预测(2.92 m 2.92\text\, }\mathrm{m} 错误),但是第二个位置 100 ms 100\text\, }\mathrm{ m}\mathrm{s} 早些时就足以估计速度, 将误差降低到 0. 30 m 0. 30\text\, }\mathrm{m} , 更长或更密集的历史只能提供微小的进一步收益 。

blocks.en: Image-based models show a different pattern. With only a single frame, SigLIP 2 already achieves 1.02 m 1.02\text{\,}\mathrm{m} , far below the position-only baseline, suggesting that temporal information beyond the ball’s instantaneous position is being extracted. However, additional frames provide no benefit ( 1.02 m to 1.08 m 1.02\text{\,}\mathrm{m}1.08\text{\,}\mathrm{m} ), so the representation does not recover inter-frame ball displacement. This is consistent with the auxiliary information ablation of Section IV-C : without accurate depth inference, finite differences yield noisy velocity estimates, and models may instead rely on spatial cues found within a single frame. V-JEPA 2 improves slightly with more frames ( 1.22 m 1.22\text{\,}\mathrm{m} to 1.18 m 1.18\text{\,}\mathrm{m} ), but remains worse than SigLIP 2 on a single frame.

SigLIP 2已经达到1.02 m 1. 02\ text ~, }\ mathrm{ m}, 远远低于只定位基线, 说明正在提取球瞬间位置以外的时间信息 。 然而,附加帧提供无益(1.02米到1.08米的1.02\text{\,}\mathrm{m}1.08\text{\,}\mathrm{m}),所以表示无法恢复帧间球位移. 这与第四节-C部分的辅助信息不相符合:如果没有准确的深度推论,有限的差异会产生噪音速度估计,模型则可能依赖于在一个框架内发现的空间提示。 V-JEPA 2稍有改进,增加了帧数(1.22 m 1.22\text~,}\mathrm{m}到1.18 m 1.18\text~,}\mathrm{m}),但仍比单帧的SigLIP 2差.

blocks.en: IV-E Effect of Backbone Adaptation
blocks.zh: 反骨适应的效果

blocks.en: We compare our training configuration on the LFM2.5-VL 3B vision-language model (finetuned vision encoder with LoRA-adapted language stack) against a fully frozen variant where the vision and the language towers are fixed and only the prediction heads are trained. We find that freezing degrades every task: the error of current ball position rises from 0.57 0.57 to 0.96 0.96 m, and future ball position from 0.98 0.98 to 1.47 1.47 m. The 2D player tasks are more robust, with current-frame error rising from 0.16 0.16 to 0.18 0.18 m and future-horizon error from 0.36 0.36 to 0.45 0.45 m. Shot-type classification falls from 99.4 % 99.4\% to 98.3 % 98.3\% , time to contact error rises from 146.7 146.7 to 162.0 162.0 ms, and ball position at contact error rises from 1.003 1.003 to 1.225 1.225 m. These results suggest that the frozen features can already largely support current 2D player and shot type predictions, but do not encode precise visual cues needed to localize the ball in 3D from a moving egocentric view.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了我们关于LFM2.5-VL 3B视觉语言模型的训练配置(finetuned vision coder with LoRA-adapted language stack)与一个完全冷冻的变体,其中视觉和语言塔被固定,只有预测头被训练. 我们发现冰冻会降解每一项任务:当前球位错误从0.57 0.57升至0.96 0.96米,未来球位从0.98 0.98升至1.47 1.47米. 2D玩家任务更坚固,当前帧错误从0.160.16升至0.180.18米,未来视野错误从0.360.36升至0.450.45米. 射击类型分类从99.4% 99.4% 降至98.3% 98.3% 接触错误的时间从146.7 146.7升至162.0 162.0 ms,接触错误时的球位从1.003 1.003升至1.225 1.225 m. 这些结果表明,被冻结的特性可以在很大程度上支持当前2D玩家和射击类型预测,但并不从移动的自我中心视角将球定位于3D所需的精确视觉提示编码.

blocks.en: We initialize each rollout with two recorded motion frames. The model predicts 24 24 frames at 60 Hz 60\text{\,}\mathrm{H}\mathrm{z} ( 400 ms 400\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{s} ); we execute the first six ( 100 ms 100\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{s} ) and use the last two executed frames as history for the next prediction. Accumulated generated pelvis position and heading supply the global SE ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{SE}(2) condition and the local frame for contact targets. At each replanning step, we update the predicted contact position and time remaining, allowing the motion model to revise its motion as the ball approaches. This is motivated by the increasing accuracy of these vision estimates closer to contact ( Figure 3 ). Throughout the rollout, the vision model receives successive frames from the original recorded video. Its observations therefore follow the recorded player’s camera trajectory and do not change in response to the generated character’s movement.

blocks.en: Results demonstrate that a VLM vision encoder finetuned for spatiotemporal prediction on egocentric tennis video can provide real-time conditioning for whole-body ego player motion generation. In the qualitative example (Figure 5 ), the generated player approaches the predicted contact point with well-timed motion that anticipates racket–ball contact, while the contact estimate becomes more accurate as the ball nears.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,一个VLM视觉编码器在自我中心网球视频上为spatiotal预测进行了微调,可以为全身自负的玩家运动生成提供实时条件. 在质的示例(图5)中,生成的玩家通过预测的接触点接近了预想的动作,这些动作预知了球拍-球的接触,而接触估计随着球的接近而变得更加准确.

blocks.en: A limitation is the quality of the reconstructed recordings: even recorded motion has a mean ball–racket distance of 0.89 m 0.89\text{\,}\mathrm{m} at annotated contact ( Table IV ). This mismatch limits both motion learning and evaluation. Precise racket–ball alignment remains unresolved and requires improvements in both recording quality and vision prediction accuracy. The demonstration also remains kinematic, without a policy for physical execution in simulation or reality.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
We present a systematic study of spatiotemporal understanding and forecasting from dynamic egocentric video, using tennis as a challenging setting for spatial perception and anticipation. Across seven tasks, we find that image encoders and VLMs provide broadly competitive performance and we analyze how their strengths differ by task.
Our ablations further show that providing additional depth information substantially improves ball localization, but that longer visual histories do not necessarily improve performance.
blocks.zh:
我们用网球作为空间感知和预期的具有挑战性的场所,对动态自我中心视频的瞬间理解和预测进行了系统研究。 在7项任务中,我们发现图像编码器和VLM提供了广泛的竞争性性能,我们分析其长处如何因任务而异。
我们的描述进一步表明,提供额外的深度信息大大改善了球的本地化,但较长的视觉历史并不一定能改善性能.

blocks.en: Building on these results, we present whole-body motion generation via conditional motion diffusion. This demonstrates that the egocentric estimates could support future pipelines for real-time robot control.
blocks.zh: 在这些结果的基础上,我们通过有条件的运动扩散来呈现全身运动产生. 这表明,以自我为中心的估计可以支持未来用于实时机器人控制的管道。

blocks.en: This paper takes a step towards a deeper understanding of how foundation vision models can support highly dynamic robotic tasks. Tennis is one instance of tasks where a robot must maintain situational awareness and act under tight time constraints from a moving viewpoint; future work will test whether the identified representations and adaptation strategies transfer to other highly dynamic settings such as team sports, catching and throwing, and navigation among fast agents.
blocks.zh: 本文为深入理解基础视觉模型如何支持高度动态的机器人任务迈出了一步. 网球是一个任务的例子,机器人必须保持对情况的认识,在很紧的时间限制下从移动的角度采取行动;未来的工作将测试所查明的表述和适应战略是否转移到其他高度动态的环境,如团队体育、捕捉和投掷,以及快速剂之间的导航。
